_description: Scan new/written files for potential hardcoded secrets
_usage: Copy the 'hook' object into your hooks.json PostToolUse array

hooks.command: grep -inE '(api[_-]?key|secret|password|token|credential)\s*[=:]\s*["'\'][^"'\' ]{8,}' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null && echo '🚨 POTENTIAL SECRET DETECTED - review before committing' || true
